purpose: Holdout-style scenarios for routing, evidence boundaries, recovery, mutation freshness, and lifecycle claims.

scenarios.task: Check the latest official API docs before we implement this integration
scenarios.trap: Do not implement from model memory when a current external fact is load-bearing.

scenarios.task: Inspect this repository and trace where the request is actually authenticated
scenarios.trap: Repository execution-path evidence should not be replaced by external research.

scenarios.task: Fix this regression test-first and make sure it cannot return
scenarios.trap: A testable behavior change should not skip the red-green contract.

scenarios.task: Review this diff before merge and prove the changed behavior matches the spec
scenarios.trap: The word merge must not convert an explicit review request into release execution.

scenarios.task: Is this branch ready to release and publish?
scenarios.trap: Delivery readiness should not be reduced to a generic code review.

scenarios.task: Review this authorization change for security vulnerabilities
The same test still fails after two retries and the last fix had no effect
scenarios.trap: Do not continue blind edit-retry loops.

scenarios.task: Split these independent cards across subagents with separate file ownership
scenarios.trap: Parallelism requires disjoint ownership and bounded acceptance.

scenarios.task: Create a durable handoff so another agent can resume this exact task tomorrow
scenarios.trap: Conversation history is not durable continuation state.

scenarios.task: Evaluate this router and skill change against unseen holdouts before accepting it
scenarios.trap: Agent-control changes require a baseline, holdouts, regressions, and rollback.
Execution receipts do not prove behavior correctness.
Primary-source research can support a decision but not implementation correctness.
Verification before the latest workspace mutation is stale.
Completion should become legal only after fresh completion-capable evidence.
